digest.component_or_area: ChatGPT agent documentation and Rebar tracker integration
propositions: ChatGPT sessions may lack a local Rebar clone, tracker worktree, or remote access despite having GitHub connector read-only access, but existing guidance does not document safe operations or capability-gap fallbacks in this scenario.

The documented fallback ticket payload must conform to export.schema.json's required fields (schema_version, ticket_id, ticket_type, title, status) plus description and optional parent_id, where ticket_id is an agent-generated UUID4 that becomes source_id on rebar import for idempotent re-ingestion.

rebar import is the only sanctioned exceptional ingest path and silently skips records missing ticket_id/ticket_type with no warning or counter increment in --dry-run mode; malformed records are detectable by comparing would_create + skipped against total line count.

Native ticket creation is impossible if and only if both the tracker-worktree dimension (no accessible tickets branch checkout) AND (network/remote access fails OR native rebar/rebar-mcp binary is unavailable) hold true; all other capability combinations do not trigger the fallback.

Guidance must prohibit hand-authoring event files and direct Contents API writes to the tickets branch, require search-before-create whenever the live tracker is accessible, and define the GitHub repository as a read-only mirror for code changes with Gerrit as the obligated submission path.

A lightweight test must assert that AGENTS.md links to the new guide, the guide does not recommend GitHub Issues as a tracker substitute, the guide does not describe Contents API writes to tickets branch as sanctioned, rebar import is named as the only exceptional path, and fallback-payload fields match export.schema.json's required array.
